description.value: Lucky Bar is a storied live-music and DJ venue in downtown Victoria, programming an eclectic range of genres — punk, metal, hip-hop, house, reggae, folk, jazz, and more — alongside variety shows and film screenings under the motto 'Everything happens at Lucky Bar.' Situated on Yates Street, it runs multiple events most nights of the week and draws a devoted local crowd. For touring cyclists, it offers an accessible evening entertainment option right in the heart of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at luckybar.ca is fully accessible and confirms the OSM record: same address (517 Yates St, Victoria, BC V8W 1K7), same URL, and adds a phone number (+1 250 382 5825) absent from OSM. The site shows a dense events calendar running through June 2026, confirming the business is active and open. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone +1 250 382 5825 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bar and live-music venue in downtown Victoria with a confirmed events calendar through mid-2026.
